shortDefinition.en: A family of camera-specific, sensor-oriented file formats used as input for later image development.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 一组相机特定、面向传感器数据的文件格式，用于后续图像显影。

en: RAW is not a single universal format or a finished image ready for every use.
zh-cn: RAW 不是单一通用格式，也不是可直接用于所有用途的成品图像。

example.en: A RAW file and an in-camera JPEG can come from the same exposure but receive different processing.
example.zh-cn: RAW 与机内 JPEG 可以来自同一曝光，但接受不同处理。

sources.title: JPEG vs. RAW — Adobe
sources.supports: Sensor-oriented data and development trade-offs in a RAW workflow.
